title: Quick Charred Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A fast and flavorful Syrian dish featuring lamb kebabs with a charred, glassy exterior, made with render-fat and fast action yeast, perfect for meal prep and onion and garlic free
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to high heat, aiming for 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together yeast, salt, black pepper, and sumac
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Brush the lamb with rendered lamb fat and olive oil
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until charred and cooked through
Brush the kebabs with pomegranate molasses during the last minute of cooking
Let the kebabs rest for 2 minutes before serving
